answer.says: You are right, Shri Hegde. The procedure is the procedure, and I am the one who must wait for it. I shall leave you to your supper.
answer.thought: His refusal is the form of the universal: the procedure exists for everyone, and my particularity must submit to it. I cannot philosophize the bureaucracy away; I can only wait for its movement. The raita waits, and so do I.
